query:
SELECT tt.type, tt.amount, tt.balanceAfter, tt.description, tt.createdAt
FROM token_transactions tt
JOIN app_users au ON tt.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.email = 'oren263@gmail.com'
ORDER BY tt.createdAt ASC;
